This function calculates and returns the factorial for the integer number given as its parameter. Note that it has no local variables.
This condition let us choose between a base case and a recursive case.
This is the base case that solves the problem in one step with no recursive calls. Indeed, factorial(0) is 1 by definition. We do not need any recursive calls and simplt return 1.
